comparison.objective: Measure two leveled scoops of formula into a bottle; unrelated to shock-absorber commissioning.
comparison.physical_skill: Scoop dipping, strike-off leveling, controlled pouring, and spill avoidance versus fine tool use and mechanical tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Requires the correct powder mass, bar-leveling history, limited spill, and released scoop; no mechanical setting or dynamic stop test. Rubric is numeric and complete.
comparison.reason: It tests bulk-material measurement and pouring rather than adjustment, locking, or energy absorption.
